words.definition: a sudden start of a disease affecting many people at the same time
words.example: The hospital reported a new outbreak of flu this winter.

words.definition: a sign in the body that shows a person has an illness
words.example: A high temperature is a common symptom of infection.

words.definition: a substance given to protect people from a disease
words.example: Children receive a vaccine to protect them against measles.

words.definition: the practice of keeping yourself and your surroundings clean to stay healthy
words.example: Good hygiene, like washing your hands, helps prevent illness.

words.definition: to stop something from happening
words.example: Regular exercise can help prevent many health problems.

words.definition: to move and affect a larger area or more people
words.example: The virus can spread quickly in crowded places.

words.definition: to identify what illness a person has
words.example: The doctor diagnosed her with a mild infection.

words.definition: medical care given to cure or control an illness
words.example: The treatment for the infection included rest and medicine.

words.definition: to become healthy again after an illness
words.example: It usually takes a week to recover from a cold.

words.definition: describing an illness that lasts for a long time
words.example: Diabetes is a chronic condition that needs constant care.

words.definition: describing a disease that can spread easily from one person to another
words.example: Chickenpox is highly contagious among children.

words.definition: the state of being healthy, happy, and comfortable
words.example: Sleep is essential for both physical and mental wellbeing.

words.definition: the way a person lives, including habits and daily choices
words.example: A healthy lifestyle includes good food and regular exercise.

words.definition: the condition of being extremely overweight in a way that is unhealthy
words.example: Obesity increases the risk of heart disease.

words.definition: the process of eating the right food for good health
words.example: Good nutrition is important for children's growth.

words.definition: a medical examination to check general health
words.example: She goes for a checkup at the doctor's office every year.

words.definition: knowledge or understanding of a particular situation or problem
words.example: The campaign aims to raise awareness about mental illness.

words.definition: having protection against a disease
words.example: A strong immune system helps the body fight infections.

words.definition: an illness caused by harmful germs entering the body
words.example: He developed an infection after the surgery.

words.definition: a series of planned activities to achieve a particular social goal
words.example: The health ministry launched a campaign to encourage handwashing.

text: In recent years, public health awareness has grown rapidly, as governments and doctors try to prevent diseases before they spread. A healthy lifestyle, which includes good nutrition and regular exercise, can reduce the risk of chronic illnesses such as heart disease and obesity. However, contagious diseases remain a serious challenge, especially when a new virus causes an outbreak. If people do not follow basic hygiene rules, such as washing their hands, an infection can spread quickly through a community. Vaccines play an important role because they strengthen the immune system and help the body fight illness before symptoms appear. When someone feels unwell, it is important to see a doctor, who can diagnose the problem and recommend the right treatment. Most people recover fully if they receive care early, although some conditions require long-term management. Public health campaigns often encourage citizens to have a regular checkup, since early detection saves lives. In conclusion, protecting our wellbeing depends not only on medical treatment but also on the choices we make every day, from what we eat to how carefully we follow hygiene advice.
